actual: The canonical v2 direct-monthly minute exporter uses nested 50-code x 3-month ANY(array) queries, batch-level resume, repeated full-market auxiliary-frame processing, and full-history structural validation. Live 2026-08-31 candidate regressed from the verified 2026-05-03 baseline of 618,578,712 CSV rows in 1h49 plus 28m dump to projected 30+ hours. Implement one shared order-stable exporter for CLI/backend/UI that reuses per-file checkpoints, queries only each symbol's missing interval through the BUG-1033 equality/index-pruned path, scopes auxiliary joins to affected symbol-dates, retains only required affected-window validation plus deterministic historical samples and consumer smoke, and preserves the existing candidate without production activation. Acceptance: resume the current candidate and complete the full minute CSV+Bin stage within 4 hours on this host without full-history hashes, source freeze, resource gates, or full-history value rescans.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
